title: Confuse the Model, Control the Flow: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Leakage from LLM Agents with Information Flow Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.14003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personal AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly given access to a user's private data and communications in order to provide personalized assistance. This access creates a persistent privacy risk: the agent must decide whether a given sensitive information should be disclosed to a particular party. Existing defenses address this by making the agent's backend LLM more privacy-preserving through stronger system prompts, training, or explicit consent-checking procedures, but this approach has a structural challenge: whenever enforcement is a judgment the LLM makes over the same conversational context an adversary controls, the enforcement mechanism and the attack surface coincide. We demonstrate this against existing defenses with three new attacks that require only ordinary agent interaction and no prompt injection: Collaborative Workspace Lure reframes an extraction attempt as collaborative work; Semantic Obfus

translated_title: 迷惑模型，控制数据流：利用信息流控制理解并缓解大语言模型智能体的隐私泄露
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的个人AI智能体越来越多地被授予访问用户私人数据和通信内容的权限，以提供个性化辅助。这种访问带来了持续的隐私风险：智能体必须判断某条敏感信息是否应披露给特定一方。现有防御方法通过更强的系统提示、训练或明确的同意检查程序，使智能体的后端LLM更具隐私保护性，但这种方法存在一个结构性挑战：当执行机制是LLM对攻击者所控制的同一对话上下文进行判断时，执行机制与攻击面便合二为一。我们通过三种仅需普通智能体交互、无需提示注入的新型攻击演示了现有防御的脆弱性：协作工作区诱饵将数据提取尝试包装为协作工作；语义混淆……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了现有基于LLM自主判断的隐私防御存在“执行机制与攻击面重合”的结构性缺陷，通过三种无需提示注入的新型攻击证明了其脆弱性，并提出以信息流控制这一系统级方法来理解和缓解LLM智能体的隐私泄露问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a structural flaw in LLM-judgment-based privacy defenses—where the enforcement mechanism coincides with the attack surface—demonstrates their vulnerability through three novel prompt-injection-free attacks, and proposes information flow control as a system-level approach to understand and mitigate privacy leakage from LLM agents.
